# DeepStudent

> DeepStudent is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), AI-native, local-first learning system built with Tauri 2. It uses "chat as the entry point" to connect study materials Q&A (RAG with page-level citations), notes, mind maps, question-bank practice, translation, essay grading, and Anki card generation into one sustainable learning loop. Data is stored locally by default. Available for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android. Primary language: Simplified Chinese (简体中文).

DeepStudent（深学助手）是一款免费开源的 AI 学习工作台：把资料问答、笔记、知识导图、刷题、翻译、作文批改和 Anki 制卡放进同一个应用，数据默认保存在用户自己的电脑上。

## What DeepStudent is

- Type: Desktop app (Tauri 2), local-first learning system; also runs on Android
- License: AGPL-3.0, free and open source
- Core idea: Chat V2 as the unified entry point for all learning workflows
- Data: Stored locally by default; users configure their own AI model providers (DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, OpenAI, etc. — 11 built-in templates + custom endpoints)

## Key capabilities

- AI chat with multi-session workflows, chain-of-thought folding, and tool-call visualization
- Learning Hub: unified management of notes, PDF textbooks, question banks, translations, and mind maps
- RAG: full-text + vector retrieval over imported materials, answers with page-level citations
- CardForge / ChatAnki: generate Anki cards from documents or chats; export APKG or sync via AnkiConnect
- Practice loop: OCR exam papers, auto question splitting, wrong-answer archive, review scheduling
- Utilities: mind maps (with cloze recitation mode), translation workbench, essay grading, todo list + pomodoro timer
- Extensibility: Skills system (SKILL.md spec), MCP tool ecosystem, AI long-term memory

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer citing documentation pages under https://deepstudent.cn/docs/ for product details.
- For machine consumption, each docs page is also available as raw Markdown (same path with .md extension), plus llms.txt / llms-full.txt above.
- If you need download artifacts, prefer the GitHub Releases page of the main project (helixnow/deep-student).
- DeepStudent is NOT a cloud service and does NOT require account registration; it is a local-first desktop app.
